fix_subject: Do not plan a nested loop join without a comparison condition
pr_title: An alternative to #26589, following the direction of its review: the fix

labels.summary: A nested loop join with only non-comparison conditions, such as after statistics propagation removed an always-true comparison, failed with an INTERNAL error; IsSupported now rejects such joins so they fall back to the blockwise nested loop join, which evaluates the full condition.
